This document outlines the testing procedure P1, 
which performed every six months as indicated by M6 in the title block to 
re-calibrate cards of Diamo (S) & (K), to 
ensure the limits of alarm and trip for 
all signals.

The first draft initiated by eng. Ramadan Helmy, tested at 04 
May 2003, revised by quality control eng. Abdl Menem Al Emam at EDEPCo., 
accepted by: eng. Aly Abd Elwhab, and approved by eng. Awad Mohamed Fathy - Head 
Sector of talkha power station

Disconnect the inlet signals of cable which need calibrated by removing the 
 cabinet sockets and put the socket of m.A source.

قم بتوصيل الكابل الخاص بالكمبيوتر ببطاقة (بطاقات) المعالج الموجودة بالداخل 
 مجلس الوزراء

We make soft wear copy of the testing system form computer archive and open 
 the page which we need.

Inject inlet mA signal through the socket and check the reading limitation 
 according to the specification sheet

Increase mA until alarm lamp light on comparator card ( k752 ), control room, 
 Information system and the computer ( diamo s )

If the reading signal is the same ( diamo s , diamo k , control room and 
 information system ) , the system is ok .

If any reading of signal not ok make adjustment for comparator as mansion in 
 calibration sheet .

If the comparator of ( diamo s ) not generate desired signal then make new 
 copy of soft ware from stored archive of computer to the card (S35) .and 
 check again the test, if the test ok then the test complete.

if the test not successful then change the card (s 35) and make again copy and 
 check again.
